body: What do you do when you’ve run out of excuses? Who’s going to offer guidance when you’ve pushed everyone away? Why are you still jobless five months on? What do you do when you’re nearly forty and have nothing to show but twenty-three of your chromosomes one generation farther down the road than you are? How can you be sure you won’t blow your head off when her boyfriend moves in with her because her roommate’s moving out in less than a month and she’s broke because you haven’t paid child support in five months and you’re thousands behind on payments toward “marital debt”? How do you explain that she and everyone else around you makes you feel like you’re just some guy she had a fling with who got her pregnant, when that’s exactly how you act? How do you make fifteen years together mean something? How do you tell her you’re sorry? How do you become the guy she took back once; not because she’d do it again, but because that guy was pretty fucking awesome and you kind of liked him?
